system_thesis_interpretation: PCFL-Stream is best understood as a controlled, predominantly off-policy systems assay of one causal path: a frozen source-life process produces a public action--outcome chronology; a target- and arm-blind writer/compiler converts only that chronology and prior supported public claims into an explicit canonical per-life corpus; the corpus is frozen before substrate assignment; one arm exposes it through bounded external text access and another trains a per-life LoRA from the identical bytes; a fixed resolver receives only the current public state/goal and its assigned memory interface, constructs a bounded cited plan, and commits world actions; only an offline scorer then sees hidden truth. The durable states are distinct: raw episodic events and supported claims are explicit declarative evidence, the canonical compiled corpus is the common causal treatment, the LoRA is lossy per-life parametric transport, and the resolver workspace is temporary goal-local state. The proposed post-native lifetime/depth/age surface can establish that this integrated frozen pipeline continues to acquire, retain, and combine independently introduced causal mappings over a finite tested range, and that authentic memory bindings cause later action under a specified read protocol. It can separately estimate writer quality, substrate transport, retrieval work, resolver composition, and whole-system action value only if the corresponding interventions and controls are kept distinct. It cannot establish that LoRA discovers structure, that weights alone retrieve without external candidate work, that the writer or controller learned across lives, that action improved subsequent evidence acquisition, that the full loop is on-policy, that performance generalizes beyond the PCFL family, or that the system beats unspecified SOTA agents. The fixed common source life is a virtue for causal attribution and simultaneously the reason this is not the complete action--experience--memory flywheel. Independent random cohorts also contain no reusable cross-cohort law, so PCFL-Stream primarily tests accumulation and finite-rate storage; genuine higher-order compression requires the separately prospective PCFL-Schema treatment or an equally explicit sublinear information/rate-distortion result.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph should be read as a sequence of sealed treatment boundaries. First, a hidden world/cohort generator samples independent mappings and a target-independent source policy emits a single immutable public life. Introduced mappings, successfully supported mappings, repetitions, and absent/failed support are separate quantities; compiler or target success may not select the life. Second, the writer/compiler sees only the eligible public prefix and explicit supported-state provenance. It must not see evaluation goals, target identities/templates, hidden cohort assignments, oracle proof paths, arm labels, capacity choice, or prior scores, and it emits one canonical corpus plus a root and per-record lineage. Third, the corpus root freezes before a trusted assigner creates raw/history, summary, linked-memory, exact graph/program, text, LoRA, twin, shuffle, or null treatments. Text and LoRA receive identical semantic source bytes, but their indexes, candidate generators, training views, optimizer state, and read interfaces remain separate causal variables and must be logged rather than smuggled into the substrate label. Fourth, a fixed resolver queries only public anchors under constant caps, accumulates returned immutable atoms in temporary working state, cites the environment-certified decisive bindings, and commits action. Fifth, the hidden executor/scorer consumes the frozen action after cognition terminates or across only prospectively enumerated public observations. No scorer, audit, resource, failure, or earlier-arm output has a return edge to generation, compilation, assignment, retrieval, training, or cognition. Cross-era targets establish target-local composition over old and recent atoms; they do not by themselves establish learned graph induction, a schema, or compression. An exact witnessed graph/program is therefore an essential strong baseline and sufficient-statistic reference, while a graph-heavy internal architecture is optional unless graph edges are independently shown necessary. The upstream J/P G1 and Bubblewrap artifacts are only admission/interface gates: neither node supplies model, interactive, PCFL, GPU, or paper authority, and neither may be treated as evidence on this graph beyond its exact narrow receipt.
loop_delta_interpretation: At each preregistered checkpoint of the same nested life, the system closes the public prefix, records newly introduced and newly supported independent mappings, and freezes the target-blind compiler state. Compilation produces one cumulative corpus without access to future checkpoints or any evaluation allocation. Before any LoRA contrast, the same-corpus text arm must show causal fixed-budget action value; this stages failure cleanly and avoids training an adapter on a useless treatment. A separately authorized LoRA stage then trains or rebuilds a fresh per-life adapter under a frozen schedule and ledger, while text, LoRA, direct-QA LoRA, batch-SFT, and external-memory arms reuse the same world-lives, targets, base model, stochastic seed plan, action budget, and appropriate matched read interfaces. Evaluation crosses lifetime with certified dependency depth and new/old/cross-era age. Every action is frozen before hidden scoring. Causal forks must be taken from the identical pre-action state: an authentic-memory arm, a target-byte-equivalent twin or binding shuffle, and a true memory cut that removes all paths carrying the decisive assignment. For a LoRA, deleting a citation from an external reader is not a weight intervention; the cut generally requires a separately bound counterfactual training corpus/adapter or another validated substrate-level intervention. Pair/world-life is the replication unit, with checkpoint, target, side, depth, age, arm, capacity, seed, and repeated actions nested. Calibration lives may tune a frozen design but cannot enter confirmation or determine capacities/thresholds. The loop stops or narrows its claim when unique knowledge does not grow, source support or compiler coverage selects easy targets, text memory is noncausal, LoRA transport fails, a strong baseline keeps improving or dominates, candidate work or retained state silently scales with the life, old knowledge is forgotten, cross-era composition fails, or the planned post-native/resource surface is infeasible. Because the source chronology is common and fixed, evaluation outcomes do not become later dream evidence and the loop is not on-policy. A future on-policy loop needs prefix-equivalent randomized memory clones in an interactive environment, memory-caused information-seeking actions, action-dependent public observations, later recompilation, and improved downstream policy value under exploration-aware estimators.
claim_delta_interpretation: A prospectively confirmed PCFL-Stream result could support a narrow finite-range claim that a frozen general resolver plus a target-blind per-life compiler transforms the agent identity's public outcome-bearing history into authentic compiled memory that causally improves later PCFL actions after the raw history exceeds native context, while preserving old mappings and composing old with new. The identical-corpus factorial can then say whether that fixed semantic treatment is transported through a specified LoRA/read interface relative to text; it cannot attribute writer intelligence, candidate enumeration, query selection, clean-base composition, or external indexing to the adapter. A lifetime-saturation claim is permitted only for each explicitly named baseline that itself meets a frozen plateau/noninferiority definition over its bounded post-native checkpoints, with simultaneous pair-level uncertainty; one arm winning at an endpoint is not another arm saturating. The result is 'better eventual action over the tested PCFL lifetimes,' not faster learning, universal SOTA superiority, standard-environment validity, or unbounded continual learning. PCFL-Stream's independent random mappings make linearly increasing information demand part of the generator. A fixed parameter count is not alone evidence of compression because serialized precision, optimizer state, external indexes/candidates, and finite overcapacity can hide increasing bits. Without a prospective schema, the honest positive term is compiled per-life parametric memory or a measured task-rate--distortion tradeoff against the exact minimal sufficient statistic. PCFL-Schema may support higher-order compression only if a pretarget committed schema predicts a fresh sparse cohort and beats atomic-only, leaked-schema, twin, binding-shuffle, exact-symbolic, text, and LoRA controls. Nothing here supports autonomous discovery, policy-selected evidence acquisition, a self-improving on-policy flywheel, generic intelligence, or a paper/claim release before a separately bound evidence review and human authority decision.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The intended matrix has the right high-level direction but is not yet an operational leakage proof. PUBLIC_LIFETIME_PREFIX_AND_GOAL must be split: the compiler may see the sealed source prefix but never evaluation goals, target templates, target allocation, or goal-derived selection signals. Likewise ARM_ASSIGNMENT_AND_MEMORY_BINDING must distinguish arm names, adapter/corpus roots, candidate indexes, capacity/rank, and counterfactual binding keys. The six aggregate stages need descendant-level expansion at least to hidden-world sampler, cohort/label/skin allocator, source action policy, source renderer, target allocator/renderer, writer, support/status checker, compiler/canonicalizer, corpus parser, adapter trainer, text index, candidate enumerator/ranker, arm assigner, prompt builder, resolver/parser, public action interface, hidden action executor, scorer, audit/resource sink, cache/reset, and analysis. For every descendant, visibility must cover target identity/template, hidden mapping/twin side, source and target split, support/failure state, proof/depth certificate, candidate rank/order/length, arm/capacity label, prior calibration/confirmation outputs, scoring, and timing/retry/error branches. Filenames, handles, serialization lengths, ordering, index ranks, candidate multiplicity, latency, failures, retries, and cache state are derived channels, not harmless metadata. Training may consume only the frozen assigned training view; text indexing and recognition-candidate generation may consume only their preregistered public memory objects, and their retained bytes/work must be counted. The resolver may observe only public goal/state and uniform interface behavior, never the arm label or contrast. Hidden truth, proof graphs, and scores become visible only after all cognition/action bytes freeze. Calibration outputs may inform a newly frozen design only on disjoint calibration lives; confirmation descendants see no tuning history. Every per-life adapter, index, cache, handle ledger, workspace, RNG state, prompt history, and process is reset between lives. The prior Bubblewrap CPU receipt covers only its exact deterministic non-model D0 batch path and cannot be inherited as model-facing or interactive PCFL isolation.
acceptance_test_interpretation: PCFL_PS_T01_UNIQUE_KNOWLEDGE_AND_NATIVE_CONTEXT_AXIS is the necessary information-growth and chronology gate. It must mechanically derive L_native from the frozen tokenizer and exact model-visible serialization/reserves, count introduced and supported unique mappings separately, prove that repeats/distractors add zero to the knowledge axis, use a total target-independent source/target constructor, retain unsupported mappings and generation failures, and establish that neither compiler output nor target outcomes select cohorts or targets. Three distinct strictly post-native checkpoints are necessary for a curve, but passing T01 is design validity, not learning or action evidence; exact 2x/4x/8x multiples should survive a prospective feasibility audit rather than become a reason to truncate failures. PCFL_PS_T02_FIXED_BUDGET_ACTION_CAUSALITY_AND_DEPTH tests memory-caused action under bounded resolution. Depth must be an independently enumerated minimal dependency/action depth with target-only headroom, not a nominal label; new, old, and cross-era scores remain separate. The decisive cut must be defined from the environment proof before observing model citations, applied before the action from an identical fork, and remove every text, candidate, cache, prompt, and parametric route to the assignment. Twin substitution must preserve all target-visible bytes and make action follow the twin-valid binding. This test can credit authentic memory plus the fixed resolver, but it cannot by itself locate credit in writer versus substrate or establish an on-policy learning loop. PCFL_PS_T03_STRONG_BASELINE_AND_SAME_CORPUS_FACTORIAL tests module attribution and comparative adequacy on common lives/targets. It needs byte-identical canonical corpus bindings; target-blind direct-QA construction; fresh per-life adapter/init and frozen exposure/order/optimizer policy; matched base, prompts, resolver/action caps and stochastic seed plan; a substrate-by-reader factorial for text and LoRA; candidate-only/base-without-adapter and wrong-adapter controls; and full accounting for external index/candidate bytes and work. Recognition-assisted LoRA is a hybrid parametric-ranking/external-enumeration condition, while unaided generative LoRA is the cleanest direct-read probe. A win supports only the specified transport contrast, not LoRA-only intelligence or SOTA status. PCFL_PS_T04_CAPACITY_QUERY_AND_SATURATION_RESPONSE_SURFACE tests the finite system frontier, not merely accuracy. It must report achieved action value against unique entropy, minimal sufficient-statistic bytes, serialized adapter bits/precision, text/index/candidate storage, active and retained state, preprocessing, compiler/training/query/resolver compute, latency, failures, and the number of downstream actions over which compilation/training is amortized. Sublinear candidate work is necessary but not sufficient for parametric recall if a growing external index encodes the binding. Each named baseline must satisfy its own prospectively frozen plateau slope/noninferiority rule; multiplicity and all three action-age subscales constrain positive language. Independent cohorts cannot by themselves establish semantic schema compression. PCFL_PS_T05_SPLIT_STATISTICS_FAILURE_AND_PROMOTION_LOCK is the preregistration and selection-bias gate. It must freeze disjoint calibration and confirmation world-lives, total generators, source behavior policy, target allocation, pair-only replication, nested repeated-measure estimator, stochastic seeds, capacity grid, missing-as-failure or other conservative handling, simultaneous intervals, plateau margins, and all stop/pivot rules before model/GPU execution. Duplicate lives, unsupported targets, compiler/training/model failures, and resource aborts remain in the assigned denominator. A J/P DEV pass or PCFL calibration may request a new exact human-ratified scope and cannot dispatch or tune confirmation. PCFL_PS_T06_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL is an authority and reproducibility gate, not a test whose success is defined as a positive reviewer verdict. A fresh reviewer should receive exact frozen bytes and raw evidence, be free to approve a null/narrow result or reject the rung, verify module-level receipts and resources, and reject every broader compression, autonomous-discovery, on-policy, generic-intelligence, external-validity, universal-SOTA, or unbounded-learning statement. The separate advocate cannot override rejection, technical validation cannot authorize a claim, and repaired evidence requires new bound review and the applicable human decision.
assumptions: The phrase 'one immutable life per world' means a source chronology produced once by a frozen target-independent behavior policy and then reused across every arm; it does not mean each evaluated memory arm collects a different adaptive life.

The base model, writer/compiler program or prompt, resolver policy, tokenizer, serialization, and all confirmation hyperparameters are frozen across confirmation world-lives; no across-life controller learning occurs in this study.

The per-life LoRA, text index, candidate store, cache, workspace, handles, RNG streams, and optimizer state are newly initialized or deterministically rebuilt within one world-life and never cross a split or life boundary.

The canonical same corpus means byte-identical semantic records and provenance before any preregistered substrate-specific rendering; any changed example wording, order, negatives, repetition, or target form is a separately named training-view factor.

Independent scale-only cohorts have no hidden reusable meta-law and contribute linear fresh mapping entropy; skins and labels are assignment-independent under exhaustive target/interface shortcut checks.
Pair or world-life, not checkpoint, target, action, seed, twin side, depth, or cohort, is the independent replication unit for primary uncertainty.

Hidden truth and oracle proofs are used only by trusted generation/certification and by scoring after action commitment, never by writer, trainer, memory reader, candidate generator, resolver, or model-visible error handling.

A successful fixed-source PCFL-Stream confirmation is intentionally non-on-policy even if target execution contains several actions; target outcomes do not alter later source experience or recompilation in this study.

ambiguities.question: Who chooses the actions that create the immutable source life, what public feedback is observed between those actions, and is the source policy scripted, randomized with logged probabilities, or model-generated before arm assignment?
ambiguities.impact: This determines selection support, whether the life is truly common across arms, what 'its own life' means, and whether any part of the experiment is on-policy.

ambiguities.question: Are target cohorts/templates sampled totally before source support and compiler success are known, or are targets restricted to mappings that became supported or were successfully compiled?
ambiguities.impact: Conditioning targets on support or compiler coverage selects easy knowledge and can manufacture acquisition, retention, and cross-era gains.

ambiguities.question: Does depth 1--4 mean minimal causal mappings needed, sequential resolver dependency steps, minimal world-action depth, or a combination, and how are alternate successful proofs enumerated?
ambiguities.impact: Without a unique operational certificate, the depth curve can measure labels or action padding rather than increased constructive demand.

ambiguities.question: At each checkpoint is the adapter incrementally continued, rebuilt from the common base on the cumulative corpus, or both, and how are example order, exposure count, optimizer state, replay, and negatives matched to batch-SFT and direct-QA controls?
ambiguities.impact: The answer changes whether the measured factor is continual updating, cumulative batch transport, training exposure, or corpus quality, and it strongly changes cost.

ambiguities.question: What exact text and LoRA read modes share a candidate universe, which object creates and retains candidates/indexes, and can candidate content or order itself encode the queried binding?
ambiguities.impact: Recognition assistance may relocate memory into an external index and turn the adapter into a reranker; identical corpus and sublinear scans alone do not identify parametric recall.

ambiguities.question: What executable intervention removes one decisive compiled atom from a distributed LoRA while holding all other training bytes, optimizer randomness, candidate behavior, and resolver state fixed?
ambiguities.impact: Masking only a cited reader return does not remove the binding from weights, while retraining a leave-one-out or twin adapter introduces training variance that must be paired and budgeted.

ambiguities.question: What are the exact capacity/rank grids and retained-byte definitions for text, graph, index, candidate store, adapter precision, optimizer state, and caches, and over how many downstream target actions is compilation/training cost amortized?
ambiguities.impact: Without a common resource denominator, a fixed-rank adapter can hide growing external state or precision and an expensive LoRA can look favorable on action value while being dominated as a system.

ambiguities.question: Which named baselines and action subscales are primary for the saturation claim, what simultaneous slope/noninferiority margin defines a plateau, and how many independent world-lives power the repeated-measures surface?
ambiguities.impact: Three post-native checkpoints do not by themselves identify saturation, and nested targets or seeds cannot substitute for world-life replication.

ambiguities.question: Does the resolver commit a complete batch plan before hidden execution, or may it observe declared public outcomes after each of up to six actions and replan within the target episode?
ambiguities.impact: This changes the causal state machine, visibility contract, action-value estimand, and model-facing isolation requirements, although neither version alone establishes the across-episode on-policy flywheel.

ambiguities.question: What finite set of world-lives, checkpoints, depths, ages, arms, capacities, training seeds, twin/cut forks, and target repetitions is the primary confirmation crossing under an explicit compute and calendar envelope?
ambiguities.impact: The literal full Cartesian product is likely infeasible at 8x native context; post-outcome pruning would create selection bias, while an unpowered sparse design would not support the proposed response surface.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The four-item, six-stage visibility matrix is too coarse to certify target blindness or noninterference, and PUBLIC_LIFETIME_PREFIX_AND_GOAL is an invalid combined information item for the compiler.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The compiler may see the sealed source prefix but must not see evaluation goals, templates, allocation, proof/depth certificates, or their derived filenames, order, length, candidate ranks, timing, retries, and failures. The trainer, indexes, candidate generator, prompt builder, parser, hidden executor, caches, and reset path are omitted despite being causal descendants and known leakage surfaces in the upstream consensuses.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split prefix from evaluation-goal/target information; enumerate the descendant stages and derived channels named in this interpretation; bind a Cartesian visibility/taint/reset artifact before implementation or any model-facing run.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal does not operationally define how the action--outcome source life is produced, so it cannot yet distinguish common-deck causal attribution from policy-selected experiential learning.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: One immutable life shared by all arms requires a single target-independent behavior policy or externally scripted stream. If each arm acts to collect its own life, the source distribution is no longer matched; if the stream is common, PCFL-Stream is non-on-policy and cannot evidence the recursive flywheel even though its records contain actions and outcomes.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze the source behavior policy, public observation timing, randomness/propensities, total failure handling, and ownership of each ExperienceEvent; explicitly label the confirmation fixed-source/off-policy and reserve randomized memory-caused evidence acquisition for a separate interactive study.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: T01 forbids target answers and target-selected evidence but does not explicitly forbid selecting targets after observing which mappings gained source support or survived compilation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Choosing only supported or correctly compiled mappings makes acquisition and retention conditional on pipeline success and removes precisely the failures the response surface must measure. Counting 'unique supported mappings' is not a substitute for retaining introduced-but-unsupported mappings in assigned outcomes.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use a total no-rejection target allocation frozen independently of support/compiler outputs, report introduced versus supported versus compiled coverage, and retain every unsupported target, duplicate, generator failure, and compiler failure in its assigned world-life denominator.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Masking every model-cited atom is not by itself a valid decisive-memory intervention, especially for a LoRA whose learned binding remains in weights.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Citations can be post-hoc, omit redundant routes, or be deleted from an external interface while the parametric association remains available. A correct action surviving such a mask need not falsify memory causality, and a changed action does not identify the substrate if prompts/candidates also change.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Precertify decisive minimal cuts and all alternate proof routes from hidden environment structure; fork before retrieval/action; for text remove all binding-equivalent records/caches/candidates; for LoRA use a bound leave-one-binding-out, twin-trained, or otherwise validated substrate intervention with paired training randomness; score both action and cited path.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Byte-identical training/source corpora do not isolate text-versus-LoRA transport unless read mode, candidate construction, and external storage are crossed explicitly.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A recognition-assisted LoRA can outsource recall to a growing candidate index and act only as a reranker, whereas exact text lookup may use a different query path. Sublinear scan work does not prove the adapter stores the binding if the index/candidate list does. Corpus equality removes writer selection but not reader intelligence or external-search confounding.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze a substrate-by-reader factorial with matched candidate-assisted text and LoRA cells, candidate-only clean-base/no-adapter and wrong-adapter cells, unaided generative LoRA, explicit text/index cells, and complete index/candidate bytes, preprocessing, calls, FLOPs, latency, and ordering receipts. Limit LoRA claims to the measured interface.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's fixed/sublinear adapter-capacity criterion is necessary but not sufficient to license compression on independent random cohorts.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A fixed parameter count can carry increasing finite information through unused capacity or high-precision values, while external indexes, candidate stores, optimizer checkpoints, and training compute grow. The independent-cohort generator deliberately has linear fresh entropy and no reusable schema, so it cannot demonstrate discovered higher-order structure merely because tested action value remains high for several finite checkpoints.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use 'compiled per-life parametric memory' for PCFL-Stream unless effective serialized bits and all external state are sublinear at matched action value against the minimal sufficient statistic; call any weaker result a finite rate--distortion/storage frontier. Reserve semantic compression for a separately prospective PCFL-Schema result.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal names plateau ingredients but does not yet define a baseline-specific saturation estimand tightly enough to support the owner's central 'other systems saturate' hypothesis.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A baseline can lose to PCFL while continuing to improve, and a fixed artificial capacity/query cap can force any external-memory system to flatten. Three post-native points and an endpoint advantage do not alone distinguish true bounded gain, degradation, noise, or an imposed resource bottleneck.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: For every headline baseline, freeze its legitimate capacity policy and matched-resource frontier, a pair-level post-native slope or gain contrast, plateau/noninferiority margin, simultaneous uncertainty, and positive-growth/endpoint criteria. Name only baselines that individually satisfy that rule; never generalize to SOTA systems not run on PCFL.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: PCFL_PS_T06 should not define its expected outcome as a reviewer approving a supported rung; a valid independent review may confirm a null, narrow the rung, return NOT_RUN, or reject the evidence.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Making approval the passing observation pressures the supposedly independent reviewer toward a positive conclusion and confuses process integrity with scientific outcome. AGENTS.md makes the reviewer non-overridable and requires new bound review after repair, not a guaranteed approval path.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define T06 success as complete independent access, reproducibility, explicit verdict, correct claim/evidence binding, and preserved rejection authority. Treat approve, narrow/null, NOT_RUN, and reject as valid terminal scientific outcomes; no technical verdict itself grants human claim authority.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Crossing every listed baseline with every lifetime, depth, age, capacity, seed, and causal fork is not automatically the highest-value or feasible paper design.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: At three or more post-native checkpoints the proposed arms, rank grids, direct/recognition readers, batch controls, and leave-one-out/twin interventions multiply adapter training and target execution dramatically. If cells are dropped after observing difficulty or outcomes, selection invalidates the surface; if all are retained without a power/resource calculation, the experiment may never reach confirmation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before implementation freeze an explicit resource and power envelope plus staged gates: generator/shortcut/depth certification, compiled-text causal screen, minimal LoRA transport screen, then a preselected primary confirmation surface. Keep diagnostic baselines on preregistered sparse cells where scientifically adequate and report the full missing/failure ledger.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Cross-era success over independently keyed local mappings must not be interpreted as evidence that DREAM learned a connected graph or compressed schema.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The target exposes a small constant set of anchors and the resolver joins their direct meanings under a known task grammar. The upstream J/P consensus already establishes that full semantic facts with graph edges deleted can solve its primary semantic assay. PCFL-Stream may therefore test bounded key-value retention plus clean-base composition even when no learned graph edge is necessary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Retain the exact witnessed graph/program as a strong sufficient-statistic baseline and add a graph-edge-deleted full-facts control. Credit graph construction only if an independently intervened edge is necessary; otherwise describe cross-era performance as resolver composition over compiled local atoms.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Exact 2x, 4x, and 8x L_native checkpoints are useful provisional anchors but should not be treated as intrinsically scientific constants if they make the only adequately replicated confirmation infeasible.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The causal scale axis is genuinely new supported knowledge beyond exact model-visible capacity, not powers of two themselves. For a large native context, 8x can dominate writer and repeated adapter-training cost while reducing the number of independent lives, which is worse for the lifetime estimand.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before implementation use tokenizer-exact serialization and CPU-only schedule accounting to freeze at least three well-separated strictly post-native knowledge checkpoints under an adequate world-life replication/resource plan. Preserve 2x/4x/8x when feasible; otherwise revise the proposal prospectively and forbid curve/scaling language until the replacement is ratified.

open_questions: Does Rohin want PCFL-Stream to be the single primary paper family only after adjudication resolves the source behavior policy, target/support selection, descendant visibility, LoRA memory cut, reader factorial, plateau estimand, replication, and feasible primary-cell surface identified here?

Does Rohin ratify the narrow scientific target as better finite-range PCFL action from target-blind compiled per-life memory, with same-corpus LoRA transport attributed separately and no SOTA, external-validity, on-policy, autonomous-discovery, graph-necessity, or compression claim unless its separate rung passes?

If compression remains a paper objective, does Rohin require a separately prospective PCFL-Schema stage, or should Paper 1 stop at compiled per-life parametric memory and a fully accounted finite capacity/rate--distortion frontier?

After consensus, will Rohin ratify exact bytes and a new bounded implementation/model/GPU scope separately, accepting that this interpretation, a green J/P DEV result, or BWRAP_CPU_INTERFACE_ISOLATION grants no implementation, model/provider, network, GPU, confirmation, promotion, or scientific-claim authority?
